title: Ramsons RTD 150
subtitle: Tumble Drier (Steam/Electric/Gas-Heated, Garment & Leather)

purposeAndApplication.purpose: The RTD 150 is a 150 kg-capacity tumble drier from Ramsons' RTD range (15/30/60/75/120/150/200), using heat exchange with a rotating stainless-steel paddle basket to dry garments, linen, or leather. Heat-exchange tumble drying of washed garments, linen, or (per the listing's product text) leather, with a programmable logic controller (auto reverse, digital temperature control, timer with pause/cool-down).
purposeAndApplication.industry: Garment / apparel finishing, commercial laundry, leather processing

overviewDescription: Made by Ramsons Garment Finishing Equipment Pvt. Ltd. (Bengaluru, Karnataka, India). Double-insulated (mineral wool) stainless steel drum with CNC-made SS paddles, reduction pulley system with closed-grain cast-iron pulleys and V-belts, self-aligning bearings, programmable logic controller. Heating by steam, electricity, gas, or thermal fluid.

finalNotes:
• Phase 1 PARTIAL PASS — Headline capacity and motor ratings are now cross-confirmed between the nameplate and the dealer listing (HP/kW figures agree once unit-converted).
• Conflicts remain unresolved on basket volume (2,980 vs 2,372 ltrs), machine dimensions (2280×2295×2580 vs 2150×2065×2570 mm), and machine weight (1,792 vs 1,400 kg). These are reported as-is rather than silently resolved, since a genuine running product change between the listing's vintage and this 2023-built unit is just as plausible as either source being wrong.
